ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the performance test. It is crucial to investigate and address the issues causing this failure to ensure optimal user experience.
insights: The homepage has the longest load time (558.5 ms) among the passing pages, suggesting that there is room for optimization.
The pricing page has the lowest TTFB (87.2 ms), indicating that the server-side performance for this page is better than the other pages.
The blog page has a moderate load time (306.2 ms), TTFB (93.7 ms), and FCP (269 ms), which can be further optimized to provide a better user experience.
